name: karmolab-js
description: KarmoLab TypeScript sources; build emits to js/ for Jekyll/GitHub Pages

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:wiki && node build.mjs && npm run test:tools && npm run test:bundles && npm run test:names && npm run audit:cache
scripts.test:behavior: npm run test:gif && npm run test:video && npm run test:trim && npm run test:voice && npm run test:pdfc && npm run test:level && npm run test:v2i && npm run test:mp3 && npm run test:p2t && npm run test:exif && npm run test:fsplit && npm run test:psign && npm run test:t2p && npm run test:qr && npm run test:imerge && npm run test:favicon && npm run test:pass && npm run test:grad && npm run test:paste && npm run test:table && npm run test:workdays && npm run test:t2i && npm run test:redact && npm run test:pdfredact && npm run test:textredact && npm run test:aspeed
scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:scripts && npm run audit:data && npm run test:live && npm run test:hub && npm run test:nojs && npm run test:pwa && npm run test:behavior && npm run audit:labels && npm run test:contrast && npm run audit:cards:fresh && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:heights
scripts.sync:tools: npm run gen:og && npm run gen:tool-pages && npm run measure:heights && npm run gen:tool-pages && npm run audit:heights && node scripts/after-sync-note.mjs
